Senator Amidala's unharmed and she's returning to the Senate with her protocol droid. We have Lord Ziro in custody. He's claiming he was forced into the kidnapping of Jabba's son by Count Dooku. Zero casualties—unless you count droids, of course.|Clone Commander Fox, reporting the successful hostage extraction to GAR headquarters|}} The '''raid on Ziro the Hutt's Coruscant club''', also known as the '''raid on Ziro the Hutt's nightclub''', took place on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. After traveling to [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro Desilijic Tiure's]] nightclub, which doubled as his [[Ziro's Palace/Legends|palace]], [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] overheard Ziro conspiring with [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], [[Head of State/Legends|leader]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. She was captured and taken to the palace dungeon where she was able to contact her [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]], [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], and inform him that she was being detained. The droid contacted the [[Coruscant Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guard]], who dispatched a team, led by [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Fox/Legends|Fox]], to storm the palace with the primary objective of rescuing the senator. The raid saw the successful rescue of Amidala and the capture of Ziro. Through the use of Ziro's [[Comm unit/Legends|comm]] equipment, contact was also reestablished with [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]], who had been ignoring communications from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] during this time due to his mistaken belief that the Republic intended to wipe out his entire [[Desilijic/Legends|clan]]. This allowed Amidala to prove that the Republic was not plotting against Jabba by exposing Ziro's hand in the true plot against him, masterminded by Dooku. Assured of the Republic's innocence, Jabba agreed to a [[Hutt–Republic treaty/Legends|treaty]] between the Republic and his clan and allowed [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Republic forces]] safe passage through [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]], giving them access to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], which had been cut off by the Separatists. ==Prelude== {{Quote|You will regret this, Ziro!''"
"''No. I think I will become ''rich'' with this.|Padmé Amidala and Ziro, as she is taken to the dungeon|audio=YouWillRegretThisZiro-TCWfilm.flac|}} [[File:Christophsismeeting.png|thumb|left|250px|Yoda dispatches Kenobi, Skywalker and Tano on their mission to rescue Rotta the Huttlett.]] In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure's]] son, [[Rotta/Legends|Rotta]], was kidnapped. The [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Gangster/Legends|gangster]] sent a call for help to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. Because the Republic was in need of the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|space lanes]] through [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] to access the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], which had been cut off by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] agreed to send Jedi aid to rescue Jabba's son. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] was sent to negotiate a [[Hutt–Republic treaty/Legends|treaty]] for safe passage with Jabba, while [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and his recently assigned [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], were dispatched to find and rescue Rotta. Jabba dictated that the Jedi had one [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] rotation to find and return Rotta unharmed to his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], or there would be no treaty. After watching Kenobi leave [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]], [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], [[Head of State/Legends|leader]] of the Separatists, entered the palace and, by way of misleading evidence, led Jabba to believe that it was the Jedi who had kidnapped his son and were conspiring to destroy him along with his entire [[Desilijic/Legends|clan]]. After Dooku had convinced the Hutt of the Republic's betrayal, Jabba angrily refused to take any communication from the [[Office of the Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Office of the Supreme Chancellor]]. Republic [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] went to the [[Ziro's Palace/Legends|palace]] of [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro Desilijic Tiure]], which also served as a [[Cantina/Legends|club]] for the Hutt's associates, on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to sway him into contacting his nephew, Jabba. She hoped to explain that the Jedi were in fact trying to help, rather than harm Jabba and his son so that the treaty with the Hutt clan could be established. [[File:Padme_spying_on_Ziro.png|thumb|right|250px|Padmé witnesses Ziro conspiring with Dooku.]] Ziro rejected Amidala's plea for aid, claiming there would be no treaty, and had her seized and escorted out of the palace. Amidala eluded her [[IG-86 sentinel droid/Legends|IG-86 sentinel droid]] escort and infiltrated Ziro's throne room, where she learned the kidnapping was orchestrated by Ziro and carried out by Dooku's Separatist forces. Amidala attempted to sneak out with the information, but she was apprehended by one of Ziro's [[sentinel droid]]s. When Dooku advised Ziro that [[Nute Gunray/Legends|members]] of the [[Separatist Council/Legends|CIS leadership]] would pay handsomely for Amidala, the Hutt had her thrown in the palace's dungeon. From her cell, Amidala was able to trick her captors into activating her [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]], allowing her to inform her [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]], [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], that she was being held captive and where she was imprisoned. ==The raid== {{Quote|Is anybody home?|C-3PO, after Coruscant Guards blast open the door|audio=IsAnybodyHome-TCWf.flac|}} [[File:CoruscantGuard-TCWfilm.png|thumb|left|250px|Fox and his troops storm the throne room.]] C-3PO contacted the [[Coruscant Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guard]] regarding Amidala's abduction and [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] the senator's [[H-type Nubian yacht/Legends|H-type Nubian yacht]] to Ziro's club, accompanied by [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Fox/Legends|Fox]], and five other Coruscant Guards. Meanwhile, Amidala was escorted back to the throne room to face her captor. Ziro felt she was too dangerous to be kept alive after being informed of her call for help in the dungeon. Amidala was incredulous that Ziro would be so bold as to kill a senator on the Republic capital of Coruscant itself, but Ziro boastfully claimed to be unafraid due to friends he held in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]. At that moment, Fox's rescue team blasted their way into the palace, destroying the [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]] guarding the entrance in the process. In the ensuing [[Lightfight|commotion]], Amidala freed herself and destroyed the IG-86 droid guarding her with an appropriated [[E-5 blaster rifle/Legends|E-5 blaster rifle]]. Taking cover from return fire, the Coruscant Guards made quick work of the remaining [[Security droid/Legends|security droids]]. After narrowly avoiding a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] bolt, Ziro slithered off his dais, making for the exit. When the last two [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] were destroyed, Amidala demanded that Ziro stop where he was as the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] surrounded the fleeing Hutt, cutting off his escape. Ziro begged his captors to believe that he was merely an innocent pawn of Dooku, professing to love Rotta, his grandnephew. ==Aftermath== {{Quote|Perhaps now you will allow the Republic to use your trade routes and hostilities can come to an end.''"
"''«Agreed. A treaty is in order.»|Senator Amidala closes negotiations with Jabba the Hutt|audio=HuttTreaty-TCWf.flac|}} [[File:Padme_talks_to_Jabba.png|thumb|right|250px|Amidala contacts Jabba the Hutt.]] Using Ziro's personal [[Holocomm/Legends|holocomm]] unit, Amidala was able to contact Jabba the Hutt on Tatooine and inform him of his uncle's treachery, forcing Ziro to confess to his nephew his part in Rotta's kidnapping. Jabba was furious at his uncle's treachery and vowed to have him punished severely, beginning with allowing Ziro to rot in [[Prison/Legends|prison]] on Coruscant.''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars – The Official Episode Guide: Season 1]]'' Unknown to Amidala until she made the call, her timely intervention saved the life of Skywalker and Tano, who had just returned Jabba's son safely to him. Jabba, who until that point believed the Jedi meant to destroy him and his clan, had them surrounded and about to be executed were it not for the information provided by the senator. Amidala was also able to forge a treaty between the Republic and the Hutt clan, which would allow [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Republic forces]] free and safe passage through Hutt Space, providing them desperately needed access to the Outer Rim Territories. After Ziro's arrest, all of his possessions were confiscated by the Republic. This also included the Hutt's [[Bartender droid/Legends|bartender droid]], [[BU-11/Legends|BU-11]]. Designed to serve elite clientele, BU-11 loathed serving the thugs that frequented Ziro's club and was relieved to freed from the Hutt's employ. After overhearing a pair of clones lamenting the bartender at the newly opened [[79's/Legends|79's]], a cantina frequented by clone troopers, BU-11 volunteered and was immediately given the job.{{FactFile2014|46|BAR 1-4|Robo-bartenders}} [[File:HatGuyAndFatGuy-HC.png|thumb|left|250px|Ziro was freed from prison by Cad Bane.]] Some time later, the [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] was hired by Jabba and the [[Grand Hutt Council/Legends|Hutt Council]] to free Ziro from Republic custody. They feared that if he remained incarcerated, Ziro might divulge sensitive information to the Republic—a holo-journal record of illegal activities conducted by the Hutt Council members.{{TCW|Hunt for Ziro}} Bane recruited a team of bounty hunters, infiltrated the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] on Coruscant, and [[Senate hostage crisis/Legends|took a group of senators hostage]], including Padmé Amidala. In order to secure the safety of the captive senators, Chancellor Palpatine was forced to issue a pardon for Ziro, releasing him from the [[Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center/Legends|Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center]].{{TCW|Hostage Crisis}} ==Behind the scenes== The raid appeared in the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]] which was released on [[August 15]], [[2008]], but was first depicted a month prior in two young reader books based upon the movie. [[The Clone Wars: The Battle Begins|''The Battle Begins'']], authored by [[Rob Valois]], and the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (junior novelization)|junior novelization]], written by [[Tracey West]], were both released on [[July 26]].{{PenguinBooks|group=1|url=nf/Book/BookDisplay/0,,9780448449913,00.html|text=The Battle Begins}}{{PenguinBooks|group=1|url=nf/Book/BookDisplay/0,,9780448449920,00.html|text=Star Wars: The Clone Wars}} Though released on the same day as the junior novelization, the raid was only given a
